summary: #smallpoems (cont) Alterior motives abound Contemplation, a key less prison walls build by the unforgiven I lay each stone myself a quarry of shattered dreams Mine the rock shovel, pick, axe, repeat Yet You can not see my prison walls
author: Greg McVerry
body_html:
#smallpoems (cont)

Alterior motives abound

Contemplation, a key less prison
walls build by the unforgiven
I lay each stone myself
a quarry of shattered dreams
Mine the rock
shovel, pick, axe, repeat
Yet
You can not see my prison
walls
